components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create/update it is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and
            that E.164 string is the stored/returned value (e.g. '0412 345 678'
            becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address. It is normalized to lower-case, and the
            stored/returned value is that lower-cased string.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-

All 262 tests pass. Here's a summary of the change.

## What I implemented

When a new owner isn't a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's **lastName + postcode** with a **different telephone**, the owner is still created and flagged with `possibleDuplicate: true` / `possibleDuplicateOf: <matching owner id>`; otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false`. The flag is persisted so it's returned on both the create response and later `GET /api/owners/{id}` (which the acceptance test relies on).

## Files changed

- **`openapi.yml`** — added two read-only response fields to the `Owner` schema: `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (int32). These regenerate `OwnerDto` at build time.
- **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `possibleDuplicateOf` Integer field (`possible_duplicate_of` column) with getter/setter.
- **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — added the `possible_duplicate_of` column to the `owners` table.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — `possibleDuplicateOf` now auto-maps from the entity; `possibleDuplicate` is derived via expression (`getPossibleDuplicateOf() != null`).
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — in `addOwner`, after the hard-duplicate check passes, scan existing owners for one with the same normalised last name, equal postcode, and a different E.164 telephone; store the first match's id on the entity before saving.

## Design notes

- The check runs **after** the existing hard-duplicate (`CONFLICT`) gate, so it only ever applies to owners that are actually created.
- Only `possibleDuplicateOf` is stored; `possibleDuplicate` is derived from it, keeping a single source of truth.
- When the new owner has no postcode, it can't "share a postcode," so the result is `false` — this keeps the existing no-postcode create tests green.
